source.construction: Complete active terminal-to-terminal trips in both source directions; all intermediate shape vertices retained between monotonic scheduled-stop projections. No straight stop-to-stop chords or downtown edge turnbacks.
source.simulation: Illustrative autonomous service timing, spacing and physical terminal crossovers; source geometry and stop identities are GTFS. Not live service, exact timetables, or surveyed vertical alignments.
source.scope: Expo Waterfront–King George and Canada Waterfront–Richmond-Brighouse; full trips continue beyond the seven authored downtown interiors. No Production Way or airport branch implied.
